rule.name: OppositeBoundAssigned
rule.message: This variable is named for one end of a pair (max, afterPath, nextIndex) but is assigned from the accessor of the opposite end (getMin(), getBeforePath(), getPreviousIndex()). A neighbouring line was copied and only one side of it was edited, so the wrong bound flows into the rest of the method and the code still compiles. Assign from the accessor that matches the name (int max = range.getMax();), or rename the variable if the opposite end is what it holds. An exception fits a name that mentions both ends.
